prelude:
template <class T> concept A = sizeof(T) > 1;
template <class T> concept AB = A<T> && sizeof(T) < 100;

pairs.A leading: template <class T> requires A<T> constexpr int f(T)
pairs.A trailing: template <class T> constexpr int f(T) requires A<T>
pairs.AB trailing: template <class T> constexpr int f(T) requires AB<T>
